exposure: Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) score (anxiety)
outcome: Incidence of shivering during caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia
Efficacy (disappearance) of treatment for post-spinal shivering
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant patients who underwent elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia in an 850-bedded tertiary care hospital.
finding: The incidence of shivering was 41.7%, significantly correlating with higher HADS scores, lower gravida, and higher levels of sensory block, while IV Tramadol was found to be superior to IV Ondansetron for treating post-spinal shivering.
